    Proposition 2.10(2): A₀ is basic #

    prop:projective-evaluation (2): "The algebra A₀ is basic and representation-finite." The vertex idempotents of A₀ are primitive (FpA0); a corner element e_i x e_j with i ≠ j has no degree-zero part (degree zero is spanned by the vertex idempotents, VxG), so an inverse pair x ∈ e_iA₀e_j, y ∈ e_jA₀e_i would put e_i = xy in positive degree (isBasic_A0).
